annotations.title: Company filings and key financials from SEC EDGAR

description: SEC EDGAR profile and latest filings for a ticker or CIK: company name, CIK, SIC code and industry, fiscal year end, state of incorporation, tickers and exchanges, plus the newest filings of selected forms (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 20-F, 6-K, S-1, DEF 14A, 4, 13F-HR, SC 13G) with filing and report dates, accession number, 8-K items and primary document URL. Optional latest XBRL revenue, net income, total assets and cash. Sources: SEC EDGAR submissions and XBRL APIs. Price: $0.01 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

amendments.description: Also match /A amendments of the selected forms (default false).

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, 1 to 10 digits. Mutually exclusive with ticker.

financials.description: Add the latest 10-K/10-Q XBRL values for revenue, net income, total assets and cash (default false).

forms.description: Comma-separated form types from: 4, 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 20-F, 6-K, S-1, DEF 14A, 13F-HR, SC 13G (default 10-K,10-Q,8-K). SC 13G also matches SCHEDULE 13G.

limit.description: Filings to return, 1 to 20 (default 10), newest first.

ticker.description: Stock ticker, e.g. AAPL or BRK.B. Mutually exclusive with cik.

name: sec_filings
title: Company filings and key financials from SEC EDGAR
